route_scope: This DAG expands the manuscript-verification route, not every possible audit outcome. A certified refutation could instead satisfy the campaign objective. Neither has been obtained.

C9000064.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 064 (Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities.; papers: Topological triviality of mu-constant families of surface singularities; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN_064.statement: The manuscript's joint ambient topological right-triviality theorem for every holomorphic mu-constant isolated surface hypersurface family over the original disk.

C_LOG_MODEL_064.statement: All four guarantees of the literal relative log-model proposition, without a mu-constant hypothesis and for every remaining parameter.

C_MARKED_MONOMIAL_064.statement: The global marked monomial reduction for every common multiple of the multiplicities in dimension three.

C_MMP_PRESERVATION_064.statement: Conditional on the exact relative MMP input, fiber pullback numerical triviality and nonextraction preserve every required marking, fiber and open-isomorphism condition, and the birational target rules out a Mori fiber space.

C_LOCAL_TORIC_064.statement: Illustrative exact local calculation for a=(2,2,3), b=6: an index-three cone subdivides into three index-one cones, all rays of height one. This is not a global-model certificate.

C_NUMERICAL_BRIDGE_064.statement: The non-log-canonical mu-constant numerical comparison, including the full boundary, Euler comparison and surface inequality, yields Wahl-invariant constancy.

C_RESOLUTION_LIFTING_064.statement: The simultaneous-resolution and ambient-lifting argument gives jointly continuous right-triviality with inverse, and removes all finite parameter covers.

C_LC_BRANCH_064.statement: The manuscript's log-canonical and low-multiplicity complementary cases yield the stated joint ambient right-triviality.
